_meta.description: Curated German / EU purchase and ownership incentives for the Retail Ops pilot seed. Hand-structured from official sources (BAFA, BMF, EAFO). Amounts in EUR. Records marked verify=true must be re-checked against the source URL before a customer demo; the 2026 E-Auto-Förderung tiers in particular should be confirmed against the BAFA Richtlinie of 19 May 2026 (BAnz AT 19.06.2026 B3).
_meta.schema: incentive_id, tier (federal|regional|utility|oem|tax), scope, name, powertrains, amount_eur | amount_rule, eligibility, valid_from, valid_to, status, source_urls[], verify

incentives.name: Umweltbonus (BAFA) - federal EV purchase premium
incentives.amount_rule: 2023: EUR 4,500 (net list price <= 40k) / 3,000 (40-65k) federal share + manufacturer share; PHEVs excluded from 2023
incentives.eligibility: Private buyers from 2023-09; ended abruptly 2023-12-17 when funding lapsed
incentives.notes: Historical; used for 2016-2023 seeded outcomes and as the 'expired' example in incentive panels.

incentives.name: E-Auto-Förderung 2026 (sozial gestaffelte Kaufprämie, 'E-Auto-Booster')
incentives.amount_rule: Socially graduated grant of approx. EUR 1,500-6,000 depending on household taxable income, number of children, and powertrain; BEV base approx. EUR 3,000; PHEV/REEV only with >= 80 km electric range and <= 60 g CO2/km; purchase or leasing (min. 36-month holding / lease term)
incentives.eligibility: Private individuals; first registration in Germany on or after 2026-01-01; vehicle on the BAFA eligible list; income proven by Einkommensteuerbescheid; applications via BAFA portal since 2026-05-19, retroactive to 2026-01-01
incentives.notes: Exact income bands and per-band amounts must be taken from the BAFA Richtlinie (BAnz AT 19.06.2026 B3) before demo; the seed models three bands (low / middle / above-threshold = 0) and lets Journey Ops edit them. The valid_to date is a placeholder for program budget exhaustion.

incentives.name: Kfz-Steuer exemption for BEVs first registered by 31.12.2025
incentives.amount_rule: Full vehicle-tax exemption for up to 10 years, at the latest until 2030-12-31; thereafter 50% of the weight-based rate (approx. EUR 5.625 per 200 kg up to 2,000 kg; 6.01 per 200 kg to 3,000 kg; 6.39 per 200 kg to 3,500 kg)

incentives.name: Kfz-Steuer exemption for BEVs first registered 2026-2030 (extension to 2035)
incentives.amount_rule: 10-year exemption, at the latest until 2035-12-31, for BEVs first registered 2026-01-01 to 2030-12-31
incentives.eligibility: Per coalition agreement; EAFO lists as announced policy. If not enacted, BEVs registered from 2026 pay 50% of the weight-based rate immediately.
incentives.notes: Seed shows this as 'announced - verify' in A3 incentive panel; TCO calc uses the conservative 50%-rate assumption unless the flag is confirmed.

incentives.name: Reduced company-car benefit-in-kind for BEVs (0.25% rule)
incentives.amount_rule: Monthly taxable benefit 0.25% of gross list price for BEVs with list price <= EUR 100,000 (0.5% above); PHEVs 0.5% if >= 80 km electric range or <= 50 g CO2/km; ICE 1%
incentives.eligibility: Employees with a company car; valid through 2030
incentives.notes: Key lever for the DE fleet / user-chooser segment (A6 accounts of type fleet; A3 talk tracks for company-car buyers).

incentives.name: Special depreciation for company BEVs (40% first year)
incentives.amount_rule: Degressive special depreciation: 40% in year of purchase, declining annually to 6%

incentives.name: THG-Quote (GHG quota) payout for BEV owners
incentives.amount_rule: Annual payment from quota traders for registering the BEV's certificate; market-driven, approx. EUR 60-150 in 2025/2026 (down from ~300 in 2022)
incentives.eligibility: Registered BEV keeper; apply via a THG service provider each year

incentives.name: Regional / municipal / utility wallbox grant (generic template)
incentives.amount_rule: EUR 200-500 toward a home wallbox from Stadtwerke or Land programmes; some utilities offer a free wallbox with an EV tariff
incentives.eligibility: Residential customer of a participating utility / municipality; the federal KfW 440 wallbox programme ended 2021 and KfW 442 (solar + wallbox) ended 2023
incentives.notes: Seed instantiates per-Bundesland examples with real utility names where public; generic amount otherwise.

incentives.name: Nordwerk Automobile leasing / Umweltprämie special (synthetic)
incentives.amount_rule: EV: manufacturer 'Elektro-Bonus' EUR 3,000 stackable with the federal grant + free 11 kW wallbox; ICE/HEV: 1.99% eff. Jahreszins Leasing 36 mo or EUR 1,500 Inzahlungnahme-Prämie
incentives.eligibility: Private buyers via Nordwerk Bank; not combinable with fleet terms
incentives.notes: Synthetic OEM program; amounts are fictional.
